column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4 the Pope's final trial
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: As expected of one who has inherited Lord $$メフィスト$$'s soul...
the next generation's $$ハ・サタン$$!!
The evil next generation's $$ゴッド$$!!
Then let us see...
whether you truly have the resolve to become this $$世界$$'s new $$ハ・サタン$$...
We shall observe you closely here...
Now! Destroy the $$大邪神$$s standing there...
and restore this $$世界$$'s $$封印$$ once more!!
Then let us see...
whether you can truly sacrifice your life to prevent this $$世界$$'s collapse...
We shall observe you closely here...
Now! Settle this with your own hand...
and restore this $$世界$$'s $$封印$$ once more!!
What is wrong...?
So in the end, you do not have
that degree of resolve after all!?
What's wrong, hey...!?
You do not have to worry about us...!
That is right...
Since all of us dying is the surest way to stabilize this $$世界$$...
this choice cannot be helped...
Besides, if you become this $$世界$$'s new ruler...
at least the white-$$羽$$ people's lives should improve from what they were...
More importantly, I think this way...
will mean the fewest victims...
There is nothing to trouble yourself over...
You had no choice
but to make that decision...
Hold on, old men!
There is no need...
for all of us to be killed by this one!!
I understand. If even one person here dies,
this $$世界$$ will not completely collapse, right...?
Then whether you are truly fit to become the next $$サタン$$...
I will test you myself!!
To so easily...
cast aside those
who have fought beside you until now...
Guh... Then let us see...
whether you truly have the resolve to become this $$世界$$'s new $$ゴッド$$...
We shall test you thoroughly here...
Now! Have the one you $$愛$$ wear that armor...
and lead this entire $$世界$$ into collapse!!
Hold it!!
There is no reason the one who kills himself to save this $$世界$$...
has to be this fellow...
The point is to stabilize this $$世界$$ once more...
by increasing the number of $$封印の鎖$$s, is it not!?
Then why not let this old man die in his place!?
I have lived rather too long already...
Besides, there is no one left in $$この世$$ with whom to share this knowledge...
What do you say? I think it is an excellent idea...!
That is a fine idea, old man!
But if we are going to stabilize this $$世界$$ anyway...
would not three $$封印の鎖$$s be better than two...?
Don't you think...!?
...Yes!
And four would be better than three!!
If there are five, perhaps...
we could safely have your $$ご主人様$$ wear the armor...
I think so too...!
There is no need for you, who are promised
the throne of the next god, to die!
Damn it... I-I will never...
allow such self-indulgence!!
Your purpose is to stabilize this black-$$羽$$ $$世界$$...
and, if possible, restore the next $$サタン$$, who inherited $$メフィスト$$'s soul, is it not!?
Then...
would it not be more convenient for you if nuisances like us killed ourselves!?
Guh... th-that is...
Very well...!!
And yet...
I never thought even the one who taught my father $$ノア$$ how to build that ark...
Lord $$大天使$$ $$ラファエル$$, would betray us...
If you are so desperate to die... very well!
I shall send you all to hell
right now!!
You must kill yourselves right now!!
